title: Genre Dominance Pivot
scenario: For each platform, calculate the percentage of games released in each genre compared to the total games on that platform.
tableSchema: games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR), ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR)
correctQuery: SELECT platform, genre, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER(PARTITION BY platform) as pct_share FROM games g JOIN ratings r ON g.game_id = r.game_id GROUP BY platform, genre;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE games (game_id INT, genre VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE ratings (game_id INT, platform VARCHAR);
